hpe_js_date_install.brief: 创建 `Date.prototype` 并安装全局 `Date` / Build `Date.prototype` and install the global `Date`

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

hpe_regex_compile.brief: 编译正则模式串为匹配程序 / Compile a regex pattern into a matcher program

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.pattern: 模式串，`NULL` 视为空模式 / Pattern string, `NULL` treated as empty

hpe_regex_compile.return: arena 中新建的正则对象 / The new regex object in the arena
hpe_regex_compile.note: 标志位初始为 0，需另行调用 `hpe_regex_set_flags` / Flags start at 0 and must be set later with `hpe_regex_set_flags`

hpe_regex_search.brief: 从指定位置起搜索主题串 / Search the subject starting from a given offset

params.re: 已编译的正则对象 / A compiled regex object
params.subject: 主题串，`NULL` 视为空串 / Subject string, `NULL` treated as empty
params.start: 起始字节偏移 / Start byte offset
params.captures: out:接收捕获组的字节偏移数组 / Receives the capture byte-offset array

hpe_regex_search.return: 匹配则返回匹配结束后的字节偏移，否则返回 -1 / The byte offset just past the match, or -1 when nothing matches
hpe_regex_search.note: `captures[0]/[1]` 为整段匹配，`[2+2g]/[3+2g]` 为第 g 个捕获组；未参与匹配的组置 -1 / `captures[0]`/`[1]` describe the whole match and `[2+2g]`/`[3+2g]` the g-th group, with -1 for groups that did not participate

hpe_regex_group_count.brief: 返回正则的捕获组个数 / Return the number of capture groups

params.re: 正则对象，可为 `NULL` / Regex object, may be `NULL`

hpe_regex_group_count.return: 捕获组个数，`re` 为 `NULL` 时返回 0 / The capture group count, or 0 when `re` is `NULL`

hpe_regex_set_flags.brief: 由标志串设置 `/i /m /s` 开关 / Apply the `/i /m /s` switches from a flag string

params.re: inout:目标正则对象 / Target regex object

hpe_regex_set_flags.note: `i` 忽略大小写、`m` 多行、`s` 让 `.` 匹配换行 / `i` ignores case, `m` enables multi-line and `s` lets `.` match newlines

js_regex_new.brief: 由模式串与标志创建正则值 / Create a regex value from a pattern and flags

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context

js_regex_new.return: 包装正则对象的 JS 值 / The JS value wrapping the regex object

js_iter_len.brief: 求可迭代值的元素个数 / Get the element count of an iterable value

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.v: 字符串、数组、Map/Set 或类数组对象 / A string, array, Map/Set or array-like object

js_iter_len.return: 元素个数，无法迭代时返回 0 / The element count, or 0 when not iterable
js_iter_len.note: 供展开运算符、`for-of` 与 `Array.from` 使用 / Used by spread, `for-of` and `Array.from`

js_iter_at.brief: 取可迭代值第 i 个元素 / Get the i-th element of an iterable value

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.v: 可迭代值 / The iterable value

js_iter_at.return: 第 i 个元素，越界或不可迭代时返回 `undefined` / The i-th element, or `undefined` when out of range or not iterable
